status: GitHub source shard only; not task-1 completion or a transitive Python closure certificate

script.caller: owning workflow job or composite step, subject to its if/needs gate
script.argv: source line plus shell continuation; detail names bound arguments/output
script.status_output_effects: inherited diagnostics and nonzero step failure unless caller explicitly uses continue-on-error; detail names produced files/outputs
script.transitive_boundary: detail names the immediate tracked Python target; imported modules and subprocesses require separate migration-owner closure
script.deletion_condition: retain until exact argv, output, status, file effects and downstream script closure are proven equivalent

inline.caller: owning workflow job or composite run step
inline.argv: inline -c or heredoc body at the source line, plus source-specific detail
inline.status_output_effects: stdout/redirection or GITHUB_OUTPUT named in detail; nonzero fails enclosing step unless caught by conditional
inline.transitive_boundary: inline stdlib program in this YAML run body; detail identifies external process if present
inline.deletion_condition: remove only after positive and negative inline-body behavior, status, and output parity

installer.status_output_effects: installs locked or requirements Python dependencies into selected environment; failed install fails step
installer.transitive_boundary: project lock or requirements named in detail; installer dependency lifecycle is external
installer.replacement: task 21 dependency split or task 22 isolated SDK decision
installer.deletion_condition: remove only after all consumers use approved replacement environment and SDK checks remain isolated

provision.argv: uses actions/setup-python with adjacent python-version and job if condition
provision.status_output_effects: action provisions Python/PATH and sometimes pip cache; not a repository Python command
provision.transitive_boundary: source-specific detail names job/consumer; action internals are external
provision.deletion_condition: remove only after all job interpreter consumers have migrated

metadata.argv: YAML value, not a run body
metadata.status_output_effects: configuration/cache/path filtering only; no interpreter launched by this line
metadata.transitive_boundary: source-specific detail names dependent action or job
metadata.deletion_condition: remove with associated consumer after migration

probe.argv: availability check, loop word or shell guard
probe.status_output_effects: may fail shell preflight if tool absent, but does not start Python/uv
probe.deletion_condition: remove only after last interpreter consumer is removed

selector.argv: shell assignment/variable propagation, not interpreter invocation
selector.status_output_effects: selects path or appends environment for subsequent calls; no Python process on this line

comment.status_output_effects: no interpreter process; quoted description is inert
comment.transitive_boundary: source-specific detail names nearby actual edge if any
comment.deletion_condition: update alongside nearby migrated command; no execution cutover
